# Agreesy — Full Technical & Product Specification (llms-full.txt)

Canonical URL: https://agreesy.com/
Last Updated: 2026-11-24
Languages Supported: German (de), English (en), Spanish (es), French (fr), Italian (it)
Hosting: Cloudflare Pages (Zero-Server Static Web App + Edge Middleware)

## 1. Problem Solved
Couples, roommates, families, and friend groups waste 20–45 minutes every evening debating what to cook or order, which movie or series to watch, which board game or video game to play, where to travel, what group gift to buy, or who handles household chores. Agreesy eliminates decision fatigue in 30 seconds through blind swiping, instant consensus matching, and fair chore roulette — with zero accounts, zero app installs, and zero server-side tracking.

## 2. Player Modes & Game Mechanics
1. **Solo Mode (1 Player):** Swipe through options; if 2+ options are liked, Agreesy launches a 1-vs-1 Knockout Duel (with optional Coin-Flip Joker) to pick a decisive winner without overthinking.
2. **Duo Mode (2 Players):** Player 1 swipes and shares a compact URL via WhatsApp/iMessage. Player 2 swipes blindly; the first mutual match triggers Sudden Death celebration.
3. **Group Mode (3–6 Players):** Each participant swipes and forwards the updated chain URL in the group chat. The final player sees the majority/consensus winner.
4. **Fair Split / Chores Mode (Anti-Match):** Tasks accepted by a player are assigned voluntarily; tasks rejected by everyone are fairly divided via interactive roulette.
5. **Super-Like & Veto Jokers:** Each player gets 1x 🌟 Super-Like (double weight, golden Super-Match celebration) and 1x 🚫 Veto per round.
6. **Surprise-Me Roulette with Exclusion Filter:** Displays all cards in the current deck as tappable chips. Users cross out anything they definitely do not want today, then spin an animated slot randomizer with haptic & audio ticks on the remaining pool.
7. **Viral Match Share Card (PNG):** Generates a high-resolution 1080×1080 PNG card client-side via HTML5 Canvas showing the winner, badge (Super-Match / Match / Random Verdict / Chore Split), and cumulative saved debate time. Shares natively via Web Share API or downloads as PNG.
8. **Saved Debate Time & Decision History:** Stored 100% locally in `localStorage` (`agreesy_history_v1`), summarizing total decisions made and estimated debate minutes saved.

## 3. Complete Deck Catalog & Stage-2 Engine
Agreesy ships with 15+ curated decks and over 300 concrete Stage-2 recommendations:
- `dinner` — Dinner Savior (cooking, delivery, takeout)
- `vegan` — Veggie & Vegan Dinner
- `movie` / `streaming` — Movie Night (80+ concrete 2024–2026 movies in Stage 2)
- `series` — TV Series Finder (concrete 2024–2026 series in Stage 2)
- `wintermovies` — Christmas & Winter Movies
- `boardgames` — Board Game Night (48 bestselling board & card games in Stage 2)
- `gaming` — Video Game Picker (80 concrete PC/PS5/Switch/Xbox games in Stage 2)
- `date` — Date Night Ideas for Couples
- `cocktails` — Cocktail & Drinks Picker
- `vacation` — Travel Destination Finder (80 concrete destinations in Stage 2)
- `gifts` — Gift Ideas Finder (60 concrete gift bestsellers in Stage 2)
- `groupgifts` — Group Gifts (Parents, Friends) & Secret Santa under €20 (48 picks in Stage 2)
- `christmasdinner` — Christmas Dinner Menu Picker (48 festive menu & kitchen picks in Stage 2)
- `nye` — New Year's Eve Planner (48 party, raclette, game, cabin & city-break picks in Stage 2)
- `chores` / `household` — Fair Household & Roommate Chore Splitter
- `custom` — Create custom polls with up to 6 custom items encoded directly in `#c=...`

## 4. Deep Linking Parameters
Any URL to `https://agreesy.com/` supports:
- `?deck=<deckId>` (auto-starts the deck)
- `&mode=solo|duo|group` (or `1`–`6`, sets player count)
- `&lang=de|en|es|fr|it` (sets interface language)
- `?d=<deckId>&from=<senderName>&lang=<lang>` (triggers dynamic personalized WhatsApp/Telegram/iMessage OpenGraph preview via Cloudflare Pages `HTMLRewriter`)

## 5. Privacy & Compliance
- Zero user accounts, zero cookies required for core gameplay, zero server-side storage of votes.
- Full GDPR/DSGVO-compliant Legal Notice (`/#impressum`) and Privacy Policy (`/#datenschutz`) in all 5 languages.
- All partner/affiliate links transparently disclose their exact target domain (e.g. `(amazon.de) *`, `(booking.com) *`, `(getyourguide.de) *`).
